MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Gorilla construction adhesive felt like a plausible next purchase because I have bought Gorilla tape twice and also bought vinyl repair cement.",
    "The small squeeze tube appealed to me as a manageable supply for repair work. I would try it without needing a large project."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The screws, T-nuts and knobs require particular sizes or matching fixtures. Buying repair supplies does not mean I currently need those exact parts.",
    "Hose clamps do not establish a need for a plumbing check valve, and repair adhesive does not imply a need for dental cement or bathroom caulk.",
    "The turning tool holder and craft magnets suggest activities I have not shown a need for, while the large tub of deck screws assumes a project I do not have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical repair supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any hardware or workshop item.",
    "Items that attach, hold or bond things seem to have been treated as interchangeable, even though their intended uses differ substantially."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Gorilla purchases make another Gorilla repair product more plausible, especially when it also connects to my adhesive purchase.",
    "Specific fit and an immediate use matter to me. I would need a matching repair task before choosing specialized fittings, fasteners or tools.",
    "My most recent purchase was another hose clamp, but its size and fastening purpose matter more than a broad connection to plumbing."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in repair supplies but assumed too many specific projects, with Gorilla adhesive providing the clearest connection to my past choices."
}
